text:
zoe (AE): Quick sync: NovaCare wants a 3-week POC starting Mon. Key asks: clear monthly reserved pricing (finance ok), throughput sizing for 8k rps peak (avg 600 tokens), and clarity on BYOK/HSM + 12mo logs.

liam (SE): they explicitly said no burst-only options. want reserved pool alternatives and an AZ-eviction fallback.

marta (Solutions): preliminary sizing: 3 reserved GPUs (A30-class equiv) handle steady 95th with our FP16 runtime; add autoscale headroom to 5 for spikes. With 8-bit quantization expect ~1.6x throughput, so 2 reserved could work if quantized only.

zoe (AE): they also asked for monthly numbers and the tradeoffs in tail latency. can we give a short table?

marta (Solutions): short bullets:
- 3 reserved (min, Dedicated eu-west-1): predictable cost, best p99; recommended baseline.
- 5 reserved (safety buffer): ~+45% cost, <10% p99 improvement on extreme spikes.
- 2 reserved + burst credits: ~-15% cost vs 3 reserved but higher p99 risk and potential queuing.

liam (SE): ops pattern: autoscale config I'd propose: min=3, target_gpu_util=0.7, max=5, cooldown=90s, plus prewarm KV job to warm caches.

marta (Solutions): prewarm snippet: ```yaml
prewarm:
  kv_warmup: true
  concurrency: 6
  ramp_seconds: 600
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 5
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.7
```

anya (Security): BYOK/HSM note: we support customer-managed keys via KMS and partner HSM wrapping as an enterprise add-on. SOC2 evidence attached in shared drive. 12mo log retention available with enterprise compliance pack.

zoe (AE): legal will need the HSM addendum template. I'll send questionnaire back with our answers by EOD Fri.

liam (SE): can Solutions produce: 1) final monthly cost table (3 vs 5 vs 2+burst) 2) p95/p99 latency estimates and cost-per-1k-responses at 512/600 tokens 3) short runbook for AZ eviction fallback?

marta (Solutions): will do. note: quantized pricing bin applies when customer opts into 8-bit runtime. I'll include assumed multipliers (q8 x1.6 throughput).

ops_bot: created ticket #SRV-9812  "NovaCare POC: reserved pricing + security pack" assigned to marta, due 2026-04-05.

zoe (AE): timeline: answers by Fri, pricing sheet Mon, infra deploy Tue. can we keep that cadence?

marta (Solutions): yes. I'll attach smoke test plan: synthetic ramp 0->8k rps over 12m, capture p50/p95/p99, and token_cost.csv. sample load command: ```bash
loadgen --target 8000 --ramp 720 --payload=chat_600.json --capture=p99 --report=token_cost.csv
```

liam (SE): add tail-latency capture and queue-depth metrics. also include notes about graceful degradation (fallback model variant with lower tokens).

marta (Solutions): will add. final note: if they require HSM key wrapping we need legal + procurement signoff before private keys are onboarded.

zoe (AE): thanks team. I'll update customer and attach SRV-9812 link. End.
